description: Arcads helps users create and edit advertising videos, images, speech, and music in their workspace. Users can browse brands, actors, voices, and collected competitor ads; upload reference media; generate assets with supported models; and trim, combine, caption, translate, animate, or enhance existing media. AI analysis and prompt building support creative preparation. Processing runs as saved jobs and may consume workspace credits.
